subject.title: fix(meeting-bot): avoid stale state during transcript and browser recovery

question: Should browser-managed Google Meet talkback remain fail-closed until the browser explicitly reports micMuted: false, accepting that unknown DOM state blocks existing realtime sessions?
rationale: This is an intentional compatibility-versus-safety policy change, not a mechanical correctness choice; current main permits an in-call session with an unknown microphone state to proceed when an audio bridge exists.

options.title: Adopt explicit-unmuted readiness
options.body: Keep the fail-closed policy, repair tab ranking, and require redacted live proof that muted and unknown states block while an explicit unmute recovers speech.

options.title: Preserve prior unknown-state behavior
options.body: Keep the existing readiness behavior for unknown microphone state and limit the PR to transcript and recovery fixes until a separate policy change is approved.

options.title: Pause the readiness change
options.body: Land no talkback-policy change until a Meet-capable environment can establish the desired operator and user behavior.

recommendation.title: Adopt explicit-unmuted readiness
recommendation.body: Keep the fail-closed policy, repair tab ranking, and require redacted live proof that muted and unknown states block while an explicit unmute recovers speech.

likelyOwner.reason: Steipete introduced the shared meeting-bot boundary and authored the stated microphone-policy proposal.
